name: Run viewer, finished run (sheet over the canvas: run #42, outcome, step story; canvas shows the taken path)
describe: Run #42 of the WhatsApp order desk opened over the canvas: Finished + "Order update sent" pills, "Run finished in 2 min 50 s", and "What happened" step cards (received WhatsApp message with its data, looked up saved data, checked a condition, asked an agent...). Use to show what a flow did for one customer message.
